description: Pauses the run, in one of two ways. mode stop (the default): every machine is stopped; fast to resume, and a stopped machine is still billed. mode release: every machine is stopped, saved in a checkpoint with all its disks, then deleted, so its compute is no longer billed (the checkpoint's storage is); resume takes a few minutes and the machines come back with new addresses. While paused nothing new joins the run and its lease (if any) is set aside. It runs in the background: call get_run until status is paused (pause_report says what each machine did). resume_run brings the machines back; end_run still deletes everything.

id.description: The run's id, from create_run or list_runs.

mode.description: stop (the default): stop the machines and keep them (still billed). release: save them in a checkpoint and delete them (compute billing stops).

name: pause_run
title: Pause run
